Overview

Settings and methods

OpenRouter Chat Completions routes to the standard OpenAI provider, with reasoning effort high. The aggregate budget is 32,768 generated tokens per example, including reasoning and all tool turns. Each API request has a hard 300-second deadline. There are no inference retries or correctness hints.

Python 3.12.9 provides its standard library and NumPy 2.5.4. Biopython is absent. macOS denies network access, subprocess creation, source/answer/credential reads, and writes outside the example workdir. Each call starts a fresh interpreter; files persist within an example. Limits are 30 seconds per call, eight calls per example, and 16,384 output characters per stream. This network restriction is enforced locally, not by an OpenRouter parameter.

Scoring requires the final-answer marker. JSON is parsed with duplicate keys rejected; object key order is ignored and array order is preserved. Numeric scalar values are compared as decimals; whitespace is ignored in other scalar answers. Truncation is a failure. Wrong answers, format failures, token caps, request timeouts, and API errors are reported separately.

Raw prompts, API/SSE responses, reasoning records, and Python traces remain local and untracked. The report contains final predictions and metrics. OpenAI reasoning summaries are not the full private reasoning trace; returned encrypted records are preserved during tool continuations.
